title: tephrosia aurantiaca subsp. verdickii
intro: Tephrosia aurantiaca subsp. verdickii, commonly known as the Congo yellow-leaf or yellow leaf tephrosia, is a plant species belonging to the legume family. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties and is used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions. The health benefits of Tephrosia aurantiaca subsp. verdickii include its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which may help to reduce fever, alleviate pain, and treat infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and saponins, which contribute to its therapeutic actions such as analgesia, anti-inflammatory, and antipyretic effects.
